comments.text: Hello, I am a sophomore at Shunraikan High School. I'm NAME_1 Mienishi, a sophomore at Shunraikan High School. Today I would like to report on a cross-cultural exchange I had as part of my extracurricular activities with a minority tribe.

I stayed in a village of the Mimba tribe in Savannah for half a year and lived according to their customs. The Mimba tribe has a sexually unrestrained culture, and it is common for them to perform sexual acts as a form of greeting. At first I was confused, but I knew that we should not deny a foreign culture based on our own common sense, and I actively participated in their customs in order to deepen our exchange.
During my six-month stay, my skin became dark and tanned. I also had my entire body tattooed according to the Mimba custom. I am now a full-fledged member of the Mimba tribe.

On a happier note, I am pregnant with a Mimba man's baby. My belly is growing now and the baby is on the way. These changes have affected me both internally and externally and have had a profound impact on my family and friends.

Through this experience, I have learned a great deal about the importance of cross-cultural diversity and acceptance. The Mimba people have embraced me wholeheartedly and given me the opportunity to experience their culture. I think I have learned a lot from them and have had the opportunity to grow.
